note: Marathon County park on a wooded two-mile peninsula in the Big Eau Pleine Reservoir, with two campgrounds about 1.4 km apart: West (46 electric sites, many facing the reservoir, beside a boat landing and the group camp) and South (60 shaded sites, 24 electric, near two boat landings). Gravel pads, vault toilets and water pumps; trails, a swimming beach and disc golf. --Claude
summary: County reservation site (live) plus Wayback captures of the county fee schedule, camping page and park page: 2026 fees $23-30 (+$10 reservation, 5.5% tax), May 1-Oct 31, reservations May 1-Sep 30 with 2-night minimum, self-register up to 3 nights, 102 public sites (106 less 4 administrative), 40-60 ft gravel pads, dump. Lakeview kept (lakeside sites under canopy ~40-60 m from shore). Split candidate (West/South ~1.4 km apart); pin move ~720 m.
flags: SPLIT CANDIDATE: two campgrounds ~1.4 km apart, each its own facility on the county reservation site and its own loop off Eau Pleine Park Rd. SOUTH: centroid 44.73645,-89.83676, 60 sites (24 electric 047-070 incl. administrative 047, 055; 36 non-electric 071-106, five of them walk-in only), $23-28, https://www.parks.marathoncounty.gov/wausau-marathon/reservation/campgrounds/4a02962c-ea10-402e-bb6d-7d7dec475b89. South's lakeside sites 072, 074, 076, 078, 080, 082 are 'shaded', ~40 m through trees.
